subject: Request: 60-day eval extension + supplemental credits for Novum AI
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@novum.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim O'Neal <tim.proc@novum.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: procurement delay — extension & pilot credits

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Novum is excited about the latency improvements we saw. Procurement has run into a multi-week review because of new security gate checks, and it looks like the PO will be delayed beyond our 30-day sandbox window.

Two asks: would Redwood consider
- extending the sandbox for 60 days from the current expiration, and
- adding an additional $12,000 of pilot credits on top of the standard PLG allotment so we can finish our scale tests?

We can share the procurement tracker and a redlined SOW if that helps (attached). We also have a procurement contact (Tim) copied — happy to coordinate.

Appreciate any help here — this POC has clear path to production if we get the runway.

Best,
Sarah Patel
Head of Platform
Novum AI

Attachments: Novum_SOW_draft.pdf
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@novum.ai>, Tim O'Neal <tim.proc@novum.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: procurement delay — extension & pilot credits

Ben / Jonas / Marissa — quick escalation asking for exec signoff.

Summary: Novum (prospect, DEAL-7421) is asking for a 60-day sandbox extension + $12k additional pilot credits due to procurement delays. They’ve had a strong initial test (see attached usage snapshot) and PRD signal looks positive; risk is they timeout and re-evaluate alternatives.

Why I recommend approving:
- They’re consistently running at our recommended token thresholds and hit 3 critical success criteria in their initial mini-PoC.
- Commercial upside looks like a >$200k ARR opportunity in 12 months if PO completes.

Constraints: standard PLG policy is 14-day extension and $3k cap w/out dealdesk/exec approval. This request is materially outside that.

Proposed one-off: 45-day extension + $8k credits, contingent on a purchase intent email or PO within the extension window. If you want to be more generous we can consider the full ask ($12k / 60d) but would prefer a short exec note.

Please reply with an approver and any conditions by EOD US tomorrow — Sarah, I’ll update you as soon as I have an answer.

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@novum.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: procurement delay — extension & pilot credits

Adding context from deal desk:
- Policy: PLG sandbox extensions >21 days or credits >$3k require director-level or above signoff. We have a small discretionary pool but not this large.
- Financial: $12k exposure without PO/commit is significant for a late-stage PLG cohort.

Attached: usage snapshot and breakdown of projected burn if extended.

If leadership approves, operations will need explicit guidance on billing holds, credit expiry rules, and whether credits can be reclaimed if terms aren’t met.

Recommend Jonas or CRO-level signoff with the conditional language (PO within X days / success metrics).

-Ben
Deal Desk Lead

Attachments: Novum_usage_snapshot_20260815.csv
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@novum.ai>, Tim O'Neal <tim.proc@novum.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: procurement delay — extension & pilot credits

I’m comfortable approving a conditional exception.

Decision (one-off executive consent):
- Grant a 45-calendar-day extension from current sandbox expiry.
- Issue $8,000 in pilot credits (apply immediately to current sandbox account).
- Condition: Novum must submit a letter of purchase intent or PO within the 45-day window. If neither is provided, any unused credits will be forfeited and account reverts to standard limits.

Please route legal/finance to prepare a short confirmation email (no full contract required unless they decide to convert). Ben/Marissa — please confirm operational controls (credit flag, billing hold, HubSpot note). Aisha — convey to the customer and request a PO timeline.

-Jonas
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Confirmed — operations will implement the approved parameters. Action items:
- Billing: add $8,000 promotional credit line with tag DEAL-7421; expiry = sandbox_expiry + 45 days.
- Finance: record as one-off credit; hold on invoicing until PO received.
- CS: flag account for prioritized onboarding check-ins (weekly cadence).
- AE (Aisha): paste the below approval language into your customer reply so legal has an audit trail.

I’ll also add the HubSpot note: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/9876543 and attach the approval_matrix.xlsx for audit.
